listing.name: Tyrian / OpenTyrian (opentyrian)
listing.summary: Explore Tyrian / OpenTyrian (opentyrian) and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Start with the required game files
steps.instruction: The official archive includes the freeware Tyrian 2.1 data. Choose Play after installation; no commercial game files or separate setup program are required.

presentation.manual_preparation: The official archive includes the freeware Tyrian 2.1 data. Choose Play after installation; no commercial game files or separate setup program are required. OpenTyrian normally stores settings, saves and recorded demos in AppData/OpenTyrian, outside Portcove backups. If upstream falls back to the executable folder, declared opentyrian.cfg, tyrian.cfg, tyrian.sav and demorec.* recordings are retained. Runtime rollback carries declared current data and does not rewind saves. Existing external copies keep their files and runtime update owner. Play has not been tested through Portcove. Linux normally uses $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opentyrian or ~/.config/opentyrian. The same declared in-folder fallback files and recordings are retained. Play has not been tested through Portcove on Linux.
